capabilities: Highlight, underline and note on PDFs, books, web pages and videos
Store every annotation as a Markdown block in a per-source note
Mark areas, draw freehand and add text boxes on PDF pages
Export annotations to Markdown, summary notes, Hypothesis JSON or annotated PDFs
Import PDF annotations and passage links from other tools
extras: OCR engine (Tesseract) is downloaded from GitHub releases on first use and checksum-verified; annotation rules are formally proved in Bend; iOS/iPadOS untested on a device; DRM Kindle books refused; needs Obsidian 1.11.4+.
intentEvidence: this one is built on Obsidian's own PDF view and editor
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF view displays documents but cannot highlight or note on them, and annotations made in other tools stay outside the vault.

relations.evidence: Nothing is loaded from the Hypothesis client any more.
Obsidian's own Copy link to selection, and the PDF++ plugin, keep a highlight as a link in a note

A PDF or EPUB in a DEVONthink database can be a note's source by its item link
are variables you can set from a CSS snippet or the Style Settings plugin
A note whose annotation-target is a YouTube link

the recogniser (Tesseract, 1.8 MB) and the data of the language you chose

summary: Reader and annotator for PDFs, ebooks, web pages and videos that keeps every highlight and note as Markdown blocks in your vault.
